mapper.select: select id, user_id, weight_date, weight_time, kg, tag, created_at from t_weight where user_id = #{userId} and weight_date between #{start} and #{end} order by weight_date asc, weight_time asc, id asc
select id, user_id, weight_date, weight_time, kg, tag, created_at from t_weight where user_id = #{userId} and weight_date = #{date} and tag = #{tag} limit 1
select id, user_id, weight_date, weight_time, kg, tag, created_at from t_weight where user_id = #{userId} and weight_date < #{date} order by weight_date desc, weight_time desc, id desc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into t_weight (user_id, weight_date, weight_time, kg, tag, created_at) values (#{userId}, #{weightDate}, #{weightTime}, #{kg}, #{tag}, now())
